sensor: Thermal: uncooled VOx, 640x512, 12 um pixel pitch, 8-14 um, NETD <=20 mK; optical: 1/1.8in 4MP CMOS
features: ultra-long-range bi-spectrum thermal + 4MP visible positioning PTZ
uncooled VOx thermal detector (640x512, 12 um), NETD <=20 mK
thermal lens 75 / 100 mm or 13-130 mm zoom; visible 56x optical zoom (6-336 mm)
IR illumination up to 2000 m; laser range finder to 2000 m (+/-0.4%)
heat detection to ~10,400 m; Optical Image Stabilization; boat and fire/smoke detection
pan 0-360 endless, tilt -45 to +90, 300 presets; 7 alarm in / 2 out
release_notes: Ultra-series ultra-long-range positioning system fusing a low-NETD 640x512 thermal channel with a 4MP 56x visible channel, 2000 m IR and a laser range finder for coastline and border surveillance.

frigate.notes: Dahua RTSP convention; channel 1 = visible/fusion, channel 2 = thermal. Not verified against a live unit.

home_assistant.notes: Dahua ONVIF (default port 80). Thermal and visible exposed as separate channels (visible = channel 1, thermal = channel 2). PTZ via ONVIF.
